answer: We formulate a cryptoeconomic mechanism where validator identities require dynamic opportunity-cost staking collateral coupled with zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs. An adversary attempting to forge k pseudonymous nodes encounters a subgame-perfect slashing penalty matrix that enforces a strictly negative expected attack utility, proving zero-cost state replication to be a mathematical fable. Consequently, honest consensus strictly dominates as the unique Nash equilibrium, reducing Sybil multiplication to an economically defunct relic.
